rulers.title: regulus or rex of Ribagorza and Sobrarbe

ledger.x: 872: Raymond I seizes Pallars and Ribagorza.
907: Muhammad al-Tawil of Huesca takes much of Ribagorza.
920: Ribagorza is back in Raymond's family.
920: Raymond I's lands are divided among his four sons.
1018: Sancho III of Pamplona takes William Isarn's portion.
1025: the rest of Ribagorza submits to Sancho III.
1045: Gonzalo dies and Ramiro I of Aragon absorbs Ribagorza.
1045: the County of Ribagorza ends as a state; the title survives as an appanage of Aragonese princes until 1598.

wars.name: Muslim attacks on Ribagorza
wars.outcome: Lubb ibn Muhammad al-Qasawi attacks Raymond I in 904 and takes 700 prisoners, among them his son Isarn; in 907 Muhammad al-Tawil of Huesca takes much of Ribagorza, including Roda and Montpedrós.

wars.name: Ribagorzan succession and Sancho III's annexation
wars.outcome: The 1010 partition between William Isarn and Mayor García (with Raymond III of Pallars), under Sancho García of Castile's intervention, ends with William Isarn killed in 1018 and Mayor's retirement in 1025; Sancho III of Pamplona holds the whole county from…

certainty.note: A mountain county of three valleys; the pages give no boundary line and the Cliopatria shapes under this name are mostly Pamplona's.
